title: genomic_pathology_extraction
description: Schema v3 for structured extraction of genomic / pathology lab reports. Extends v2: (a) other_molecular_biomarker_umbrella is reshaped to the nested findings[] grouping (one biomarker, N method-keyed findings); (b) Genomic_Variants gain optional specimen_id + assertion; (c) two new sections — significant_findings (multi-specimen pathology narrative; team built in 2b) and clinical_information (built in 2a) — bring content parity with the production prompt. Provenance for a grouped finding IS its occurrences[] (one entry per mention, block_id/page/char/surface). report_metadata and tested_biomarker_umbrella are byte-for-byte the v2 shapes so Phase-1 ground truth still scores. Field-level VERBATIM vs DERIVED semantics live in each field's 'extraction_mode' annotation; multi-fragment concatenations use the ' | ' (space-pipe-space) separator. NOTE: this schema is consumed by core/schema_loader.py which does NOT resolve $ref — every shape is inlined on purpose.

count_of_extracted_objects.description: Total count across all umbrella arrays (other_molecular_biomarkers + tested_biomarkers + specimen_findings). Derived, not extracted.

provenance.description: Per-field provenance. PREFERRED shape is an ARRAY of entries [{field_name, block_id (string|null — cite a DocAI block_id), page (integer|null), type ('verbatim'|'inferred'|'derived'|'absent'), rationale (string, recommended when type='inferred')}] — one entry per emitted field. (A legacy field_name→entry map is also accepted.) Array form so structured output can enforce it. Powers the UI's block-centric explorer + the SME trace's per-field reasoning.

total_pages.description: Number of pages in the source PDF (from page count, not from report text).

report_title.description: Report title / report header banner literally as printed.

llm_confidence_score.description: Model self-reported confidence for this section, 0.0-1.0.

Patient_MRN.description: Patient Medical Record Number. STRICT: only extract when the source label is literally 'MRN', 'Medical Record #', or 'Med Rec #'. Do NOT confuse with Accession Number, Case Number, ID #, or Specimen ID.

Patient_DOB.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Convert if source uses MM/DD/YYYY or DD/MM/YYYY.

Vendor_Name.description: Lab vendor that produced the report (NeoGenomics, Tempus, Foundation Medicine, Caris, etc.). May be inferred from product markers (e.g. 'xT' → Tempus, 'FoundationOne' → Foundation Medicine) when not explicitly named. If neither explicit nor inferrable, null.

Test_Name.description: Test or panel name as printed (e.g. 'JAK2 V617F Mutation Analysis - Quantitative').

Practice_Name.description: Ordering practice / clinic name. NOT the testing lab vendor. Critical disambiguation.

Practice_ZIP_4digit.description: ZIP+4 suffix (4 digits) when present, otherwise null.

Report_Type.description: Production-parity field. The report type/category as printed (e.g. 'Surgical Pathology', 'Molecular', 'Cytology', 'Hematopathology'). null if not stated.

Accession_Number.description: Production-parity field. Accession / Case Number as printed (e.g. '7220225/MOL25-157872'). This is NOT the MRN.

Signing_Pathologist.description: Production-parity field. The pathologist who signed out / electronically reviewed the report (e.g. 'James Liang, CGMBS, MB(ASCP)CM').

Ordering_Provider_Phone.description: Production-parity field. Ordering provider's direct phone, if printed (distinct from the practice phone). null otherwise.

Additional_Provider_Name.description: Production-parity field (addition_provider_name). A second/treating/copy-to provider when the report lists one beyond the ordering provider. null otherwise.

other_molecular_biomarker_umbrella.description: THE single biomarker umbrella (v3 merge — production folds variants into biomarkers, so there is no separate variant section). One object per biomarker, tagged by `biomarker_class`: protein-expression markers (ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67, PD-L1 by IHC → `protein_expression`), aggregate molecular scores (TMB, MSI, HRD → `molecular_score`), AND gene sequence variants (JAK2 V617F, BRAF V600E, fusions → `sequence_variant`). A finding's `result` is the call as printed ('Positive (95%)', '2+', 'Not Detected', 'V600E'); when that finding IS a sequence variant, the OPTIONAL nested `variant_detail` object carries the genomic specifics (verbatim HGVS + hgvs_normalized, gene-source class, clinical significance, exon, VAF, ...). protein_expression / molecular_score findings leave `variant_detail` null. Each biomarker's `findings` array has ONE entry per distinct test/method; each finding's `occurrences` array has ONE entry per restatement of that result.

provenance.description: Per-field provenance — PREFERRED an ARRAY of [{field_name, block_id, page, type ('verbatim'|'inferred'|'derived'|'absent'), rationale}] (legacy field_name→entry map also accepted). One entry per emitted field in THIS biomarker record (e.g. biomarker_name). Array form so structured output can enforce it. Powers the SME trace's per-field reasoning + the explorer.

biomarker_name.description: Biomarker / gene identity: a protein-expression marker (HER2, ER, PR, Ki-67, PD-L1), an aggregate score (TMB, MSI, HRD), or a gene symbol for a sequence variant (JAK2, BRAF). Call biomarker_normalize / hgnc_normalize for the canonical identity key (dedup); keep the verbatim surface in occurrences.

biomarker_class.description: DERIVED category that lets a consumer filter without re-deriving it: `protein_expression` (ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67/PD-L1 by IHC — a Positive/Negative/%/intensity result), `molecular_score` (TMB/MSI/HRD aggregate), or `sequence_variant` (a gene point mutation / indel / fusion / CNV-as-variant — its finding(s) carry a populated `variant_detail`). One biomarker = one class. null only if genuinely undeterminable.

specimen_id.description: OPTIONAL (gap #9). The specimen this biomarker belongs to on a multi-specimen report; null otherwise.

page_number.description: First page the biomarker is seen on (derived from occurrences).

needs_review.description: OPTIONAL escalation flag. Set true when this record relied on an inference that changed a literal token (OCR context-correction, low-margin synonym match) or an unresolved ambiguity, so it must be independently verified (VMAW in Phase 3; SME in Phase 2). See PHASE_2_VMAW_TRIGGERS.md.

review_reason.description: Why `needs_review` is set. null when not flagged.

findings.description: One entry per DISTINCT test/method for this biomarker. 'HER2 IHC 2+; HER2 FISH amplified' → two findings under one biomarker.

provenance.description: Per-field provenance — PREFERRED an ARRAY of [{field_name, block_id, page, type, rationale}] (legacy map also accepted). One entry per emitted field in THIS finding (result, method, interpretation, …). Powers per-field reasoning in the SME trace.

method.description: Assay method (IHC, FISH, NGS, PCR, ...). Call method_normalize for the dedup key. null if not stated.

result.description: Result verbatim ('Positive (95%, strong intensity)', 'Equivocal (Score 2+)', 'Negative', '80%'). Preserve units.

details.description: Any additional info about the test (e.g. 'by IHC', '22C3 antibody'). null if none.

interpretation.description: Clinical interpretation as printed ('High', 'Low', 'Stable', 'ER positive'). null if none.

assertion.description: medspacy ConText assertion (gap #7). null if not assessed.

method_source_type.description: Binding provenance for `method`: where it came from — an explicit cell, an inherited column/section header, or distributed across a name-list. Header-inherited/distributed methods are lower-trust and get verified.

occurrences.description: Provenance (gap #8) — ONE entry per restatement of this finding, each with its block + verbatim surface. On a MERGE every surface is kept here, so the page's literal wording is never lost.

superseded.description: true if this occurrence was overridden by an addendum/amendment (gap #1); the amendment block wins the canonical slot.

variant_detail.description: OPTIONAL. Present ONLY when this finding is a gene SEQUENCE variant (point mutation, indel, fusion, CNV-as-variant). Carries the genomic specifics that a plain biomarker result doesn't have. Leave null for IHC protein-expression results (ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67/PD-L1) and aggregate scores (TMB/MSI/HRD) — those are fully described by the finding's result/method/interpretation. The biomarker's `biomarker_name` holds the gene symbol; this object holds the change detail.

gene_symbol.description: HGNC-preferred gene symbol (JAK2, BRAF, ERBB2, ...). Call hgnc_normalize; usually equals the biomarker_name for a variant.

variant_allele_frequency.description: VAF as printed (e.g. '12%', '0.34'). String to preserve units.

genomic_dna_change.description: HGVS g. notation VERBATIM as printed (e.g. g.5073770G>T).

genomic_reference_sequence.description: NC_ accession of the genomic reference.

coding_dna_change.description: HGVS c. notation VERBATIM as printed (e.g. '1849G>T' even without the 'c.').

transcript_reference_sequence.description: NM_ accession — PRESERVE the version integer (NM_004972.4 ≠ .3).

amino_acid_change.description: HGVS p. notation VERBATIM as printed (e.g. 'V617F' even without the 'p.').

amino_acid_reference_sequence.description: NP_ accession of the protein reference.

clinical_significance.description: Pathogenic / Likely Pathogenic / VUS / Likely Benign / Benign — or narrative as printed.

genomic_position.description: Genomic coordinate as printed (string to preserve formatting).

hgvs_normalized.description: The HGVS-CANONICAL forms (with c./p./g. prefixes, version-aware) from hgvs_validate — SEPARATE from the verbatim fields above so the printed surface is preserved AND the normalized form is shown.

page_numbers.description: Pages where the tested-biomarker list / panel grid appears.

tested_biomarkers.description: Alphabetized, deduplicated list of every gene / biomarker tested in the panel that has (or could have) a result — the production `biomarkers_tested_with_result`. HGNC-preferred symbols where applicable. Do NOT list molecular sequencing test METHODS (NGS, MSI, FISH, IHC) as biomarker names.

biomarkers_tested_no_result.description: Production-parity (pathology_biomarkers_mentioned.biomarkers_tested_no_result). Biomarkers that WERE tested but returned no definitive result, each with the reason (QNS / Pending / Indeterminate / Equivocal / Not reported). Empty [] when none.

significant_findings.description: Multi-specimen pathology narrative (built by the SpecimenFindingsTeam in Phase 2b). One entry in specimen_findings[] per specimen (or one aggregated entry when specimens cannot be separated). Mirrors the production significant_findings shape.

provenance.description: Per-field provenance — PREFERRED an ARRAY of [{field_name, block_id, page, type, rationale}] (legacy map also accepted). One entry per emitted field in THIS specimen-findings record. Powers per-field reasoning in the SME trace.

specimen.description: Specimen identity rows. One per labelled specimen (A, B, ...).

procedure.description: Procedure used to obtain the specimen (e.g. 'Core Biopsy', 'Excisional Biopsy', 'Resection').

specimen_count.description: Total specimens collected for this procedure; null if not specified.

text.description: Entire gross description text for this specimen.
Entire microscopic description. May live under 'Final Diagnosis', 'Diagnosis', 'Pathologic Diagnosis', 'Opinion', 'Impression', or 'Surgical Pathology Consultation'.

interpretation.description: Clinical interpretation; null if not specified.

ancillary_studies_findings.description: High-level summary of ancillary studies (IHC, FISH, NGS). Detailed biomarker results still live in the biomarker umbrellas.

pTNM_stage.description: Full alphanumeric AJCC pTNM staging string (T, N, M components).

staging_system_version.description: CRITICAL — the staging authority + edition (e.g. 'AJCC 8th Edition') scanned from the text around the TNM scores.

lymph_node_status.description: Overall status (Positive / Negative / Tumor present / Benign).

number_of_lymph_nodes_positive.description: Count of nodes with malignancy (incl. micrometastases / ITCs if counted positive).

text.description: Nodal findings block (extranodal extension, deposit size, sentinel vs non-sentinel).

clinical_information.description: Clinical history + reason for study (built by the ClinicalInfoTeam in Phase 2a). Mirrors the production clinical_information shape.

provenance.description: Per-field provenance — PREFERRED an ARRAY of [{field_name, block_id, page, type, rationale}] (legacy map also accepted). One entry per emitted field in clinical_information. Powers per-field reasoning in the SME trace.

clinical_history.description: One object per distinct clinical-history entry.

reason_for_study.description: Stated reason for the pathology examination.
